checklists.name: COBOL & Mainframe Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Enterprise COBOL structure, COPYBOOK definitions, CICS transaction safety, and JCL execution.

items.statement: COBOL source code adheres strictly to four DIVISION structures (IDENTIFICATION, ENVIRONMENT, DATA, PROCEDURE).
Data items use standardized COPYBOOK structures with explicit level numbers (01, 05, 10) and picture clauses (PIC X, PIC 9).
Packed decimal (COMP-3) arithmetic fields include sign clauses and overflow/truncation guards.
IBM CICS commands (EXEC CICS LINK/XCTL/READ) handle RESP and RESP2 return codes without unhandled ABENDs.
JCL batch job steps specify valid COND parameters, DISP status settings, and dataset name (DSN) governance rules.
EBCDIC to ASCII character code conversions are validated when interfacing mainframe feeds with distributed systems.
